`class MapSignal<K, V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Map<K,V>>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.iterable` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MapSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/iterable/MapSignal.java)

Signal of a map that keeps the insertion order of its keys, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies its followers.

## Description

It works like [`ListSignal`](/reference/signals/listsignal/): the value is a read-only copy, each method writes a changed copy, and the read methods record the read.
The keys keep the order in which they were first put.
